constraints: Should only be used within the On Clicked form event; verify in Design mode that this event is enabled on the form and/or the specific object.

overloadMerges.note: Signature 'Right click : Boolean' has no parameter list, so autoparse's regex (which requires a top-level '(...)') never matched and the returns field was left unset entirely; restored it here as Boolean per the parameter table's Function result row.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns True if the right mouse button was clicked (within an On Clicked event), otherwise False.
